answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 38418 Country: Pakistan Title: I have masturbated for about more than 8 years. I have quitted it since last 2 years. Today my age is 20 Question: I have masturbated for about more than 8 years. I have quitted it since last 2 years. Today my age is 20. When I use tissue after passing urine, it sticks with the place of urination. In my university, since last year, I often have to lead prayers. I wanted to know that whether I am eligible of leading prayers or not. If not then what should I do for the prayers I have already leaded? Answer ID: 38418 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 863/720/B=1433) If only after urination the stickiness is visible and after istinja this fluid does niether discharge nor you have doubt of it, then your salah is valid and your imamah as well. But if the case is different then write the complete detail and submit the question again. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
